title: Width truncation of a circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit on $n$ variables and let $w$ be a natural number. Its width truncation retains from the first layer just the terms of width at most $w$, preserves the first-layer gate type, and adjusts the remaining circuit layers to receive inputs from the retained terms.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a depth circuit on $n$ variables
